summary: Use parser os to set the OS directly instead of deriving it, such as ios for pyATS or linux instead of fedora.
questions: How do I force a specific OS name in cli_parse?

answer_card.title: Set a custom OS for the parser
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    command: show something
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.pyats
      os: ios          # instead of iosxe

- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    command: ps -ef
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.native
      os: linux        # instead of fedora
```
